name: Learning and Certification Crew
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Researcher
members.responsibility: Collect and organize approved official materials.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only document access when I provide files
approvalActions: A person makes legal, medical, financial, and policy decisions
members.firstTest: Answer one narrow question using at least three approved sources and identify any unresolved conflict.

members.name: Professor
members.responsibility: Explain concepts and create practice questions.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only access to approved learning materials
approvalActions: A person selects authoritative materials and evaluates formal credentials
members.firstTest: Assess one narrow topic and produce a one-week study plan with five practice questions.

members.name: Coach
members.responsibility: Quiz the learner and help review errors.
requestedCapabilities: Optional read-only access to approved calendar or planning documents
approvalActions: The user chooses every goal and action
A person makes all life, career, employment, medical, legal, and financial decisions
It is not a therapist, doctor, lawyer, or financial adviser, and it asks before contacting anyone or changing a schedule
members.firstTest: Use one current, low-stakes decision to compare two options and define one reversible next step.

members.name: Planner
members.responsibility: Build and adjust the study schedule.
approvalActions: Ask before assigning people or committing dates
Ask before changing an external task system
A person approves assignments and deadlines
members.firstTest: Create a two-week plan from one approved objective and identify every missing decision.

handoffOrder.action: Map official material to a realistic sequence.
Explain the current topic and examples.
Run a quiz and record errors.
Adjust the next cycle from progress.

approvalActions: Add outside material as an authority
